entries.zh: 同气（同胞一体）；同心同路、意愿与道路一致
entries.en: brethren of the same breath; at one in will and way
entries.notes: 西语词头尾部 a corda 标记 [残]，全句释义不全；据可读头部与 H 栏同氣互证定释义

entries.zh: 雷同（随声附和）；相同、一致
entries.en: to echo another, concur; to be identical

entries.zh: 一（数词）；一个接一个、依次
entries.en: one; some in order, one by one

entries.zh: 逐个（一个接一个）；单独一个
entries.en: each one singly, one by one
entries.notes: M 栏音写 tiox inasolo 标记 [残]（混入非汉字音写），释义据 L 栏 uno solo 与 H 栏逐互证，音证不足

entries.zh: 一丁、单个（一名成年男子）
entries.en: a single one; one adult male

entries.zh: 一片（片状之物）；一件东西
entries.en: a piece, a slice; a thing

entries.zh: 又（再、又，兼及另一者）；两者都
entries.en: again, also; both one and the other

entries.zh: 丑时（子夜后一时，即凌晨一时至三时）
entries.en: one o'clock after midnight; the Ox hour (1-3 a.m.)
both one and the other; and also

entries.zh: 单身（独自一人；无家眷的单身汉）
entries.en: single, unattached; a bachelor (man without family)
entries.notes: 西语词头带划除号标注，系誊抄删改痕迹，释义仍完整可读
西语词头带圈选号标注，圈选痕迹不影响释义

entries.zh: 接连而来（一个又一个地来；汉字辨认存疑）
entries.en: one after another they come; both are coming
entries.notes: H 栏首二字标注 [疑:悖/情]，释义主要依 L 栏 uno y otro viene 与 M 栏 chun chun lay 推定，汉字待核

entries.zh: 一家（同一户人家、一家人）
entries.en: one family, one household; of one house

entries.zh: 隔冥隔日（隔天一次；一日有一日无）
entries.en: every other day and night; one day yes and the next no
